name: ApprovalDecisionComposer
tagline: The Approval Decision Composer is the approver's side of an approval.
description: The Approval Decision Composer is the approver's side of an approval. It shows the request (title, amount, your authority limit and how long you have left), lets you pick an outcome, asks only for what that outcome needs, checks your organisation's rules, and records a clear, audit-ready decision note.
features: Outcome picker (Approve, Approve with conditions, Request info, Reject, Delegate, Refer up) with keyboard radio navigation
A conditions checklist with custom conditions
Comment templates and minimum comment length, conflict-of-interest declaration
Authority-limit rules (block, refer up or warn), review-and-confirm step
Undo window and a recorded-decision summary
Writes the outcome and a readable decision note to bound columns and raises OnSubmit / OnDecisionChange / OnUndo events with typed outputs
